changes.text: 韩信和张耳带着数万人，准备东下井陉去打赵国；赵王歇和成安君陈馀把军队聚在井陉口，号称二十万。账面上兵力悬殊（赵军二十万是号称之数），难处在另一头：据赵营中李左车的分析，汉军是乘胜离国远斗，粮食势必落在后面。就在交手之前，他向陈馀递上一条非常具体的方案，方案没有被采纳。这一篇要说的就是这条被否掉的计，以及打赢之后，赢家怎样对待出计的人。

Han Xin and Zhang Er were marching east with tens of thousands of troops, bound to attack the state of Zhao through Jingxing. King Xie of Zhao and the Lord of Cheng'an, Chen Yu, massed their forces at the Jingxing pass under a strength they claimed at two hundred thousand. On paper the gap was wide (Zhao's two hundred thousand was a claimed figure). The trouble lay elsewhere: as Li Zuoche, in the Zhao camp, saw it, the Han army was riding its victories far from home, and its grain was bound to fall behind. Before the two sides came to blows, he put a very specific plan to Chen Yu, and the plan was turned down. This piece is about that rejected proposal, and about how the winner treated the man who drew it up once the fighting was over.
韩信先令裨将传飧，说「今日破趙會食」，诸将都不信，只假意应诺。他对军吏解释：赵军已先占据便利之地筑营，在没见到我军大将旗鼓之前，不肯攻击前军，怕我军走到险阻处就退回去。韩信于是派一万人先行而出，背靠河水列阵。赵军望见，「大笑」。按诸将事后引用的兵法，布阵要右背山陵、前左水泽。作者推测，背水列阵违背了这条常规，赵军或因此发笑；但原文只记了大笑，没有说他们笑什么。

Han Xin first had his lieutenants pass round a light meal, announcing that they would eat together that day once Zhao was broken. None of the generals believed it; they feigned assent. He explained to his officers that Zhao had already built its camp on favorable ground and, until it saw the general's banners and drums, would not attack the vanguard, for fear that he would turn back on reaching the difficult ground. He then sent ten thousand men ahead; they went out and formed up with their backs to the river. The Zhao army saw them and roared with laughter. By the manual his generals later quoted, a proper line kept hills at the right rear and water at the left front. The author's guess is that this breach of the rule is what drew the laughter; the text records only that they laughed, not why.
埋伏的二千轻骑等的就是这一刻：赵营空了，他们驰入营垒，拔掉赵旗，插上二千面汉军红旗。赵军在前面不能取胜、又抓不到韩信，想回营时，看到的是「壁皆漢赤幟」，大惊，以为汉军已经把赵王和将领都拿下了，队伍顿时乱了，将领杀人弹压也止不住。汉军前后夹击，大破赵军，斩成安君于泜水上，擒赵王歇。

The ambush had been waiting for exactly that. With the Zhao camp emptied, the two thousand riders swept in, pulled down the Zhao banners and raised two thousand red ones of Han. Unable to win in front and unable to catch Han Xin, the Zhao troops turned for their camp and found the walls all hung with Han's red banners. Greatly alarmed, they were sure the Han had already taken the king of Zhao and his generals. The army dissolved; commanders cut men down to hold the line and could not. The Han struck from both sides, routed the Zhao army, killed the Lord of Cheng'an on the banks of the Zhi, and took King Xie alive.

dispositions.rationale: 把“兵力对比一目了然”及对应英文改为账面上兵力悬殊，并注明赵军二十万是号称之数。原文二十万为“號稱”，陈馀也说汉军号数万、实不过数千，真实兵力并不确定。

evidence.quote: 今韓信兵號數萬，其實不過數千

dispositions.rationale: 在一万人先行之前补入两件事：传飧时宣布「今日破趙會食」，诸将不信、假意应诺；韩信向军吏说明赵军未见大将旗鼓不肯击前军。中英同步，ev 增加 J-E12；兵法常规出自诸将之问，ev 一并加入 J-E8。

evidence.quote: 令其裨將傳飱，曰：『今日破趙會食！』諸將皆莫信，詳應曰：『諾。』
趙已先據便地爲壁，且彼未見吾大將旗鼓，未肯擊前行，恐吾至阻險而還

dispositions.rationale: 英文“Beaten in front”说重了，改为“Unable to win in front”，与中文“不能取胜”及原文“已不勝”一致。中文本来准确，原样保留。

evidence.quote: 趙軍已不勝，不能得信等
